def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The colored crossbars divide the canvas into equal-sized cells;
    # the upper-right cell is the pattern to repeat in every cell.
    sep_r = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    sep_color = grid[sep_r][0]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h))]
    row_ranges = [(0, sep_r), (sep_r + 1, h)]
    col_ranges = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols:
        col_ranges.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    col_ranges.append((start, w))
    # Use the first row-band, rightmost column-band as the source motif.
    r0, r1 = row_ranges[0]
    c0, c1 = col_ranges[-1]
    motif = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ra, rb in row_ranges:
        for ca, cb in col_ranges:
            if rb - ra != len(motif) or cb - ca != len(motif[0]):
                continue
            for dr in range(rb - ra):
                out[ra + dr][ca:cb] = motif[dr][:]
    return out
